topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by framing cancer evolution, microenvironmental influences, and the learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Clonal Evolution and Epigenetic Drivers of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer progression is driven by the Darwinian selection of fit mutant clones alongside non-mutational epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cellular hierarchy, stemness properties, and specific cells of origin determine tumor initiation and propagation across leukemia and colorectal models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Inflammatory Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters and chronic inflammatory signaling cooperate with driver mutations to induce stem-like states and drive neoplastic outgrowth.

topics.label: Established Microenvironments, Analytical Methods, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss stromal dependencies in established tumors, the modern single-cell and spatial technologies used to investigate microenvironmental interactions, and the overarching synthesis of cancer coevolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session with brief closing remarks and a look ahead to the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
